items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Compare decreases to the new source revision**

When a graph refresh legitimately removes or renames a symbol, the prescribed `--repo-ref <base>` makes the script read the pre-change source via `git show <base>:<path>`, where the removed definition still exists. It therefore reports the correct lower count as `REGRESSION` rather than explained, forcing a manual exception for every legitimate deletion and undermining the automatic gate. Pass the revision that produced the new graph (normally `HEAD`) instead of the previous graph's base.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
items.disposition: pending-revise:T43-r3 (--repo-ref must be the revision the new graph was built from; confirmed by re-reading def_lines/min(old,defs) semantics)

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Package the coverage tool with the global UA rules**

For an AGMSG graph-refresh task in any repository other than dotfiles, this required relative command cannot run: `ua-symbol-coverage.py` is present only in this repository's `scripts/` directory, while the Claude/Codex rules and orchestration skill are installed from `home/` for use across repositories. Ship the helper in the managed shared skill tree (and invoke that managed path), or otherwise provision it in each target repository before making its output mandatory.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L11-L14](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/557502bbfbd6bf02f4f1f1d313be12814a99a2e0/AGENTS.md#L11-L14)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
items.disposition: pending-revise:T43-r3 (ship the helper on PATH via home/dot_local/bin/common so the global rule can run outside dotfiles)

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Fail closed when the source revision cannot be read**

If `--repo-ref` is absent from a shallow checkout or is mistyped, `git show` fails for every path, but this branch returns `None` and the caller labels each lost file `gone` and `explained`. A graph that drops every symbol then exits successfully, bypassing the coverage gate. Validate the revision separately and treat a failed `git show` as a missing file only after confirming that the revision itself resolves.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
items.disposition: fixed:99c1174

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Add the new UA policies to the canonical AGENTS.md**

The new graph-acceptance and worker-scope policies are repository-wide rules, but they are added only to runtime-specific copies and do not appear in the root canonical `AGENTS.md`. This leaves the canonical instruction source incomplete and makes the policy prone to divergence between agent surfaces; add the canonical rules there and retain any runtime-specific translations as mirrors.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L7-L7](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/1843dd1db353501f1e2a2c6f071e0dd7d156e3ad/AGENTS.md#L7-L7)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
items.disposition: not-applicable:the UA policy is a global user rule (home/dot_config/claude/rules, applied to every project) with its Codex mirror in home/dot_config/codex/AGENTS.md; the repository AGENTS.md holds dotfiles-repo rules only

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Recognize uv-script Python executables**

Extensionless Python executables launched through `uv run --script` are not recognized as Python because only a `.py` suffix or `python` in the first line is checked. This repository's `home/dot_local/bin/common/executable_permgate` has the `uv` shebang and 16 UA function/class nodes, so a legitimate source deletion in that file is always reported as `REGRESSION` rather than explained, forcing a manual exception for valid graph refreshes. Detect Python script metadata (such as `requires-python`) or otherwise recognize this supported executable form.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
items.disposition: pending-revise:T43-r3 (recognize the `uv run --script` shebang as Python in def_pattern)

items.body:
The following taps are not trusted:
  aws/tap
  azure/bicep
  hashicorp/tap

Homebrew is currently ignoring formulae, casks and commands from these taps because tap trust is required.

Prefer trusting only the specific formulae, casks or commands you need.
Trust installed formulae from these taps with:
  brew trust --formula azure/bicep/bicep
  brew trust --formula hashicorp/tap/packer
Trust other specific casks and commands with:
  brew trust --cask <user>/<tap>/<cask>
  brew trust --command <user>/<tap>/<command>
Whole-tap trust is broader and includes all current and future formulae,
casks and commands from the listed taps. Trust whole taps with:
  brew trust aws/tap azure/bicep hashicorp/tap
Untap them with:
  brew untap aws/tap azure/bicep hashicorp/tap
To disable trust checks:
  export HOMEBREW_NO_REQUIRE_TAP_TRUST=1
This is not recommended and will be removed in a later release.
For more information, see:
  https://docs.brew.sh/Tap-Trust
